home.title: Quiz'in: quiz, bluff and drawing games on your TV
home.description: Turn your TV into the game show of the night: the question shows up on the TV, everyone answers on their phone. Free, no ads, no account, 2 to 20 players.

help.title: Help · Quiz'in
help.description: Trouble showing the game on the TV or joining? Here are the most common answers.

home.heroTitle: Turn your TV into the game show of the night.
home.heroSub: Quiz, bluff, drawing games: the question shows up on the TV, everyone answers on their phone. Free, no ads, no account, and guests have nothing to install.
home.heroMeta: 2 to 20 players · for family and friends
home.illustrationAlt: A TV shows the game code FM57 and a QR code; next to it, a phone joins the game.
home.stepsSub: No controllers, no account to create.

steps.title: Pick a game
steps.text: The host opens Quiz'in, then picks a game and a theme.

steps.title: Show it on the TV
steps.text: They cast the game to the TV with a Chromecast, or open the link on a computer connected to the TV.

steps.title: Guests join
steps.text: A QR code or a 4-character code is all it takes. They play in their phone browser, nothing to install.

home.soonText: New games are in the works.

band.title: 2 to 20 players
band.text: From 4, you can also play in teams

faq.a: To show the game on the TV, yes: a Chromecast or a TV with built-in Chromecast. Otherwise, open the link on a computer connected to the TV.

faq.q: Do guests need to install the app?
faq.a: No, they scan the QR code (or type the code) and play in their phone browser.
Nothing: the app is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.
No, neither for the host nor for the players. A first name is enough.
